 an hour ago Liverpool make six changes for tonight’s Champions League encounter with Villarreal at Anfield.
 By James Carroll
 Previous Next The Reds recall Ryan Gravenberch to midfield after he served a one-match Premier League suspension at the weekend, while there is also a start for Trey Nyoni.
 Elsewhere, Kostas Tsimikas begins in defence, while Cody Gakpo, Lewis Koumas and Rio Ngumoha are also named in the XI for the league-phase fixture at Anfield.
 Liverpool: Alisson, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Mac Allister, Gakpo, Tsimikas, Araujo, Gravenberch, Nyoni, Koumas, Ngumoha.
 Subs: Mamardashvili, Woodman, Gomez, Kerkez, Wirtz, Isak, Barcola, Chambers, McConnell, Danns, Laffey.
